text:
maria: Quick prod question — thinking about adding an SLO-aware evacuation hedge for canary/A-B. Idea: if node-level SLO breach (p95 latency > target) during rollout, route a small percent of traffic to a warm backup variant and run explicit probes. Thoughts?

ken: Love the idea. We need firm defs for "SLO breach" and some hysteresis. 30s blips should not trigger a full hedge. :eyes:

jay: +1. Also call out cache/cold-start hit — warm backups need priming otherwise we pay huge tail latency. Pre-warm during any ramp step.

maria: Agreed. Draft proposal: breach = p95 > target for 3 consecutive 1m windows AND error rate > 0.5%. Hysteresis: require 5m of healthy windows to clear. Pre-warm: background priming kick when ramp > 1%.

sam: How does this interact with ramping vs immediate fallback? If backup starts getting traffic do we decay the canary weight or just mirror?

maria: Plan: automated hedge does a soft split (80% backup / 20% canary) for probe_duration (30s). We run the probe set over that window. If probe fails, cut canary to 0 and trigger rollback. If probe passes, resume ramp after 2 consecutive probe-success windows.

lee: Need operator escape hatch. oncall-bot should post a card with actions: force_keep, force_cut, mute, plus PagerDuty link. Human-in-loop for ambiguous cases.

oncall-bot: [bot] Created incident stub P12345 for canary-hedge trigger — actions: force_keep | force_cut | mute. Ops link: https://ops.redwood/incidents/P12345

maria: Also cost control: hedge should have a top cap (e.g., 5% of global traffic) for non-critical features so we don't spin up huge cold pools.

ken: For multi-variant (quantized vs full) pipelines we should prefer cheaper variant in same family as backup before falling back to previous model. Circuit-level preference: cheapest-compatible -> warm backup -> full rollback.

jay: Implementation sketch: controller subscribes to telemetry stream, maintains sliding p95 window, evaluates state machine and emits actions (start_hedge, probe, cut, rollback). Keep config small and feature-flagged.

maria: Quick config draft: 
```yaml
hedge:
  breach_windows: 3
  window_duration: 60s
  probe_duration: 30s
  probe_traffic: 0.2
  max_hedge_traffic: 0.05
  backoff: 300s
```

sam: Dashboard needs: canary-hedge-events, probe-pass-rate, backup-cache-warmness, hedge-cost-estimate. Also alerting for repeated flaps.

maria: I'll write an RFC follow-up with the state machine diagram and an ops playbook (manual rollback checklist, PD flow). @ken please review controller API (subscribe/decide/act). Add unit tests that simulate cold-start penalty and flapping.

ken: I can take API review. If we get +1s by EOW I'll open a minimal controller PR and a tiny oncall-bot integration that posts the action card.

lee: +1 on playbook. Add a step: "If hedge triggered during business hours, notify product toggle owner".

maria: Thanks — filing RFC follow-up now. I'll include sample probe set, metrics queries, and the minimal YAML. Will ping when draft is up. :thumbsup:
